why: aged_context_rule.json's SLOW / FAST cut-offs were absolute (3 ATR(t) in 5 bars, two big bodies, any push). A smoke test on another market, before any of its results were read, showed them labelling 90% of returns FAST and none SLOW, walks included, so its primary cell is nearly empty. Its run finished and is reported as run; this is the corrected version, frozen before its run
unchanged: the trades (aged_zone_rule.json), the HTF states (ALIGNED / NEUTRAL / COUNTER, closed HTF bars only), the cells, the primary's form and the pass conditions

manner.speed: (highest high of the up to 10 bars before the fill bar, not before the zone went live - zone top) / (ATR at the bar before the fill x sqrt(bars)): how fast price fell into the zone, in volatility at the return; known before the fill
manner.SLOW / MEDIUM / FAST: the lower, middle and upper thirds of speed; cut-offs from the real rows of each venue and timeframe (no outcome used) and applied to that venue's walks
manner.also: big5 and push (aged_context_rule.json's ingredients) kept as reported attributes

primary: every origin (ALL), SLOW & ALIGNED, any wait, E1, fresh coins, 4h and 1d pooled
passes_if: R > 0 with day-bootstrap 90% interval above 0, positive before and after 2024-01-01, above the same cell on iid and GARCH walks, and above the zones that are not SLOW & ALIGNED
